# Migration spec: inventory-service

## Summary
- Containerized microservice deployed on Amazon EKS in us-west-2
- Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL database with multi-AZ resilience
- Minimum 2 replicas with autoscaling up to 6 based on CPU
- 99.9% availability SLO with p95 latency under 300 ms at 40 RPS
- Monthly budget capped at USD 450 using Graviton instances

## Key decisions
| Decision | Value | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Platform | Amazon EKS | G1, TC4 |
| Region | us-west-2 | TC1 |
| Database | Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL | TC3 |
| CPU Architecture | Graviton (arm64) | TC2 |
| Autoscaling Metric | CPU | NFR3 |
| Replicas Minimum | 2 | NFR3 |
| Replicas Maximum | 6 | G3, Q-01 |
| Logging | JSON to stdout | NFR5 |
| Secrets Management | AWS Secrets Manager | SEC1 |
| Encryption | At rest and in transit | SEC2 |

## Risks
- Traffic growth may exceed current sizing; monitor and scale as needed
- Data migration requires careful planning to avoid downtime
- Legacy endpoints may need additional testing for compatibility

<!-- generated: tables rendered from the validated spec -->

## Target specification

| Area | Values |
|---|---|
| Target | eks in us-west-2, Kubernetes 1.33, arm64, IaC terraform, registry ecr |
| Workload | port 8080, probes /healthz and /readyz, replicas 2-6 on cpu 70%, peak 40 rps, p95 300 ms |
| Data | postgres 16 on rds, Multi-AZ yes, migrate from sqlite |
| NFR | SLO 99.9%, RPO 15 min, RTO 60 min, logging json-stdout |
| Security | secrets aws-secrets-manager, encryption at rest yes, private DB yes, non-root yes, read-only root FS yes |
| FinOps | USD 450/month (prod), prefer Graviton yes, growth x3 next year |
